name: Local notifications and reminders
description: Permission request, one-off and daily local notifications, cancellation, foreground presentation, and a reminder settings view.
usage: Keep one `NotificationPresenter` alive in the App (for example `@State private var presenter = NotificationPresenter()` and call `presenter.install()` in init or onAppear) so notifications show while the app is open. Use `ReminderModel(scheduler: LocalNotificationScheduler())` with `ReminderSettingsView(model:)` for a daily reminder, or call the scheduler directly for one-off notifications. Ask for permission when the user turns reminders on, not at launch.
statusNote: Not yet built on a Mac; run `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify local-notifications` on a Mac with Xcode.
